_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Lighting Control are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

settingsUi.resourceBoundary: OpenRGB installation and service lifecycle are managed by the optional OpenRGB resource. This page reports its status and reconciles saved lighting after that owner starts or reconnects it; it does not install or start a backend itself.
settingsUi.setupSummary: Set up the optional OpenRGB backend
settingsUi.setupIntro: Run these supported commands from a Vrooli terminal. Installation and device access are opt-in and limited to platforms qualified by the resource.
settingsUi.setupCommands:
vrooli resource enable openrgb
vrooli resource source openrgb managed
vrooli resource install openrgb
vrooli resource start openrgb
vrooli resource status openrgb
settingsUi.setupAfter: After the resource reports ready, return here and reconcile the saved policy. Review resources/openrgb/docs/OPERATIONS.md for support and recovery details.
settingsUi.notAvailable: Saved policy settings are not available yet.
settingsUi.saved: Policy settings saved and the selected policy was evaluated. Per-zone command results show what the backend accepted.
settingsUi.recoveryNote: Saved desired policy is reconciled after API startup, backend reconnect, and controller return. Pre-service firmware lighting may remain visible until the backend starts.
settingsUi.ownerIntro: Choose the OpenRGB source, prepare its exact artifact and device policy, then explicitly enable headless lighting.
settingsUi.physicalUnverified: SDK readiness does not verify physical light output.
settingsUi.existingHint: An empty digest asks the owner to verify the compatible existing installation and return its exact artifact.
settingsUi.managedHint: Use the pinned release and an approved machine-local device policy. Setup verifies the selected artifact before enablement.
settingsUi.setupDoesNotEnable: Preparing setup leaves lighting disabled. Enablement saves intent, while the runtime reports launch and SDK readiness separately.
settingsUi.ownerActionFailed: The lighting owner action could not be completed.
settingsUi.refreshAfterError: Refresh the owner status before another action because the previous request may have reached the owner.
settingsUi.themeSessionOnly: This theme applies for this page session. Browser preference storage is unavailable.
settingsUi.deviceDiscoveryHint: Discover supported lighting candidates, review the exact access changes, then apply the selected device policy.
settingsUi.devicePlanMissing: The owner returned an incomplete device-access plan.
settingsUi.deviceReceiptMismatch: The device-access receipt does not match the selected plan.
settingsUi.deviceListEmpty: The supported device list is empty.
settingsUi.devicePrivilegeRequired: This plan requires a privileged local operation.
settingsUi.deviceNeedsSudo: Use a local terminal for the privileged operation described by the owner, then refresh setup status.
settingsUi.deviceRefreshAfterError: Read device status again before retrying the retained plan.
